answer: An answer must include the first 25 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the pigment derivation is checked against the trellis nonce, the ocean audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 89 aliases produces 89 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
